name: Cindy Reinert
why: Her studio senior portrait, the only posed frame of her in the volume; the alternative is a candid from a dormitory feature.
caption_quote: CYNTHIA S. REINERT, Mathematics, Pewee Valley
note: Fifth and last name in the right-hand list for the bottom row of five portraits on p. 364, and fifth portrait in that row. The list runs in printed order and the row matches it by sex (Donna Read f, Ray Read m, Charles Redmon m, Ralph Reid m, Cynthia Reinert f). Tied to the SGA roster by the 1976 index, Reinert, Cynthia Sue 24-25, 63, 364, page 63 being the ASG attendance roll that lists Cindy Reinert.

name: Sherry Casebier
why: Her studio junior portrait; the only other frames of her in the volume are group photographs where the face is smaller. The junior grid prints small, so the crop is 224 pixels wide.
note: Junior grid, nine portraits to a row and nine names to a name block. Casebier is the ninth and last name of the second block, so the rightmost portrait of the second row; the row matches the list by sex throughout (Cardwell f, Carnall m, Carpenter f, Carrico f, Carson m, G. Carter m, M. Carter m, Casada f, Casebier f). The index carries two Sherry Casebiers, and only Sherry Lee is given page 63, the ASG attendance roll that lists Sherry Casebier.

name: Bruce Smith

name: James Keffer
why: His studio freshman portrait. The alternative is a two-man full-length shot on p. 406 of the same volume where his head is smaller than this whole crop; the freshman grid prints small, so this is still only 218 pixels wide.
note: Freshman grid, nine portraits to a row and nine names to a block. Keffer is the eighth name of the eleventh block, so the eighth portrait of the eleventh row, and that row matches the list by sex right across (R. Jones f, Joynes m, Juett f, Kane f, Kavanaugh m, Keelin f, Keen m, Keffer m, Keller m). The 1975 index gives Keffer, James Thomas pages 154, 406 and 413, and p. 406 names him as freshman class president on the ASG; the 1976 index gives the same man page 63, the ASG attendance roll listing James Keffer. The Talisman calls him Jay in prose and James Thomas in the grids.

name: Tom Hayes
why: His studio sophomore portrait, the only posed frame of him in either volume; the sophomore grid prints small, so the crop is only 220 pixels wide.
note: Sophomore grid, nine portraits to a row and nine names to a block. Hayes is the second name of the fifth block in the lower section, so the second portrait of that row; the row is pinned at both ends by its only two women, Georgette Haynes fourth and Robin Hefner ninth, and the seven men fall exactly where the list puts them. The 1976 index gives Hayes, Thomas Vernon, Jr. pages 63 and 390, page 63 being the ASG attendance roll listing Tom Hayes, while the other Thomas Hayes in the index has no page at all. Confirmed independently against p. 406 of the 1975 Talisman, a photograph of the two freshman class officers captioned Jay Keffer, president (right), and Tom Hayes, vice-president: Hayes is therefore the Black man standing at the left of that frame, which is the man in this portrait. He also served 1974-75.

name: Beth Elliott
why: Her studio freshman portrait, the only photograph of her in either volume; the freshman grid prints small, so the crop is only 219 pixels wide.
note: Freshman grid, nine portraits to a row and nine names to a block. Elliott is the fifth name of the sixth block, so the fifth portrait of the sixth row. The row lines up with the list: the three men in it, Steven Edwards first, Ron Eiler fourth and John Ellis ninth, are the first, fourth and ninth faces, and the five women named after Eiler are the five women in positions five to eight and two. Gale Elliott, a different student, is the portrait immediately to her right. The 1975 index gives Elliott, Beth Ann page 409 and the 1976 index gives the same name page 63, the ASG attendance roll listing Beth Elliott.

name: Paul Stamp

Spears m, Speer f, Spencer m, Springer f, Stagner f, Stamp m, Staynings m, Steely m). name: Ricky Johnson
why: His studio junior portrait. The only other frame of him is p. 109 of the same volume, where the printed crop cuts him out of the picture and leaves only a hand on the document; the junior grid prints small, so this is 227 pixels wide.
note: Junior grid, nine portraits to a row and nine names to a block. Johnson is the fifth name of the first block below the Taking a tumble feature, so the fifth portrait of that row. The block holds only two men, Norman D. Johnson third and Rickie Johnson fifth, and the third and fifth faces are the only two men in the row. The index entry Johnson, Rickie Allen 109, 284, 388 ties this portrait to p. 109, the page whose caption names him with Tom LaCivita as ASG treasurer. The Talisman spells him Rickie; the roster and the 1976 ASG attendance roll both read Rickie, the archive reads Ricky, and the difference is left flagged rather than fixed.

name: Cindy Coslett
why: Her studio senior portrait; the only other frame of her in the volume is a large group photograph on p. 272 where she is one of twenty-three faces.
note: First of the five names in the first block on p. 313, so the first portrait in the top row of five, and the row matches the list by sex (Coslett f, Courtney f, R. A. Cox f, M. A. Cox m, R. G. Cox m). The index entry Coslett, Cynthia Sue, 245, 273, 313 is the only Coslett in the volume.

name: Clair Parrish
why: Her studio sophomore portrait; the only other frame of her is a loosely arranged garden group of twenty-three women on p. 273. The sophomore grid prints small, so the crop is 258 pixels wide.
note: Sophomore grid, six portraits to a row and six names to a block. Parrish is the fifth name of the seventh block, so the fifth portrait of the seventh row, and the row matches the list by sex (Parker f, Parks f, R. B. Parrent m, R. W. Parrent m, Parrish f, Parsley f). On the name: the roster and a group caption on p. 273 of this volume both read Clair Parrish, while the index and the grids read Clara Mae Parrish; she is the only female Parrish in the volume, the index entry Parrish, Clara Mae, 62, 70, 245, 270, 383 covering the same pages, so they are one person. The spelling difference is flagged, not fixed.

name: Mary Coleman
why: Her studio freshman portrait; the only other frame of her is a loosely arranged garden group of twenty-three women on p. 273. The freshman grid prints small, so the crop is 251 pixels wide.
note: Freshman grid, six portraits to a row and six names to a block. Coleman is the fourth name of the first block, so the fourth portrait of the top row, and the row matches the list by sex (Cole m, L. Coleman f, M. R. Coleman f, M. L. Coleman f, Coley m, Collard f). Three Colemans sit on this page; the index entry Coleman, Mary Louise, 226, 227, 273, 397 is the only one carrying p. 273, the group caption that names Mary Coleman, so Mary L. is the right one of the three.

name: Candy Mason
why: The only photograph of her in the 1971, 1972, 1973 or 1974 volumes. She sat for no class portrait, so this is a crop from the Panhellenic Council group on p. 273.
caption_quote: Row 1 ... Patty Skaggs, Candy Mason, Cheryl Mack
note: The caption gives the group in two named rows, Row 1 of ten and Row 2 of thirteen, and the photograph has exactly ten seated in front and thirteen standing behind, so Row 1 is the front. Mason is the ninth of the ten front names, so the ninth face from the left in the front group. The left-to-right order was checked against three faces already cut from this block: Cindy Coslett is Row 2 name three and the third standing face is her long-haired blonde senior portrait; Mary Coleman is Row 2 name ten and the tenth standing face is the woman with the large afro of her freshman portrait; Clair Parrish is Row 1 name five and the fifth seated face is the dark bob of her sophomore portrait. The 1972 index gives Mason, Candace Carla only p. 234.

name: Julie Bush
why: The only usable photograph of her in the 1971, 1972, 1973 or 1974 volumes. She sat for no class portrait, so this is a crop from the Panhellenic Council group on p. 273.
caption_quote: Row 2 ... Janice Lancaster, Julie Bush, Nancy Manar
note: The caption gives the group in two named rows, Row 1 of ten and Row 2 of thirteen, and the photograph has exactly ten seated in front and thirteen standing behind, so Row 2 is the standing row. Bush is the sixth of its thirteen names, so the sixth standing face from the left. The left-to-right order was checked against three faces already cut from this block: Cindy Coslett is Row 2 name three and the third standing face is her long-haired blonde senior portrait; Mary Coleman is Row 2 name ten and the tenth standing face is the woman with the large afro of her freshman portrait; Clair Parrish is Row 1 name five and the fifth seated face is the dark bob of her sophomore portrait. The 1972 index gives Bush, Julie Ann only pp. 236 and 273.

Sullivan f). The index entry Stuebing, Susan Gayle, 224, 262, 263, 390 is the only Stuebing in the volume.

name: Huston Monarch

McDivitt is the seventh name of the first block on p. 428, so the seventh portrait of the top row, and the row matches the list by sex right across (McBride m, McCamish f, McClave f, B. McCoy f, M.
